# About Me
Brian Kwon, as an aspiring Data Scientist, is currently pursuing a graduate degree in Data Science and Analytics at Georgetown University. His career journey began with a passion for understanding the impact of policies, which led him to discover the power of statistics and data science in shaping meaningful outcomes. His current interests include machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, and computer vision. Outside of academics, He enjoys playing guitar, listening to lots of music, cooking foods, solving Rubik’s cubes, and reading books.
